title: Model What Matters: Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling for Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.19642v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. translated_title: 建模关键内容：面向语言智能体的决策引导式选择性世界建模
translated_abstract: 强化学习为大型语言模型驱动的智能体提供了一种直接优化任务目标的机制，但任务奖励通常是稀疏的轨迹级信号，仅用于评估任务是否成功，无法直接监督动作条件下的环境状态转移，导致模型对动作后果和环境动态的显式理解十分有限。近期的工作通过策略与世界建模协同训练的方式引入辅助监督，但通常将完整的环境观测不加区分地统一作为世界建模目标，忽视了观测内容在决策相关性上的差异。我们提出了DGS-WM（决策引导式选择性世界建模），这是一种面向语言智能体的决策引导式策略-世界建模协同训练方法。DGS-WM采用一个决策引导的观测选择组件，基于观测单元的决策价值筛选出具有决策价值的观测单元作为世界建模目标……
tldr: 提出DGS-WM方法，通过决策引导的观测选择机制让语言智能体的世界建模只聚焦于具有决策价值的观测内容，从而弥补稀疏任务奖励无法监督环境动态理解的局限。
en_tdlr: DGS-WM enables language agents to selectively model only the decision-relevant parts of observations during policy-world model co-training, overcoming the limitation that sparse task rewards fail to supervise the understanding of environment dynamics.
